note: Section 3 (relationships & people) of the Angel cluster. Q103 and Q128 are the two closed sets the page actually closes (the Desshi Pacification Squad's clan composition, and the hotel group the Angel reveals herself to), staged in _jjk_page_angel.decl3.yaml (G6, declared-roster-wins); the 40 fact questions cover Angel's relationships -- Hana Kurusu (symbiotic vessel), the Heian-era Desshi Pacification Squad, Kenjaku (the deal she struck, now opposed), Sukuna (the 'Disgraced One' she most strongly wants to kill), the present-day sorcerers she allies with, and the Culling Game / Shinjuku Showdown beats. Golds are NFKD-verbatim on the Angel page and present in the live bundle; the roster candidates the page does not close and the unstated relationship predicates are retired with reasons.

retired.question: Every member of the Desshi Pacification Squad
retired.reason: The page does not enumerate the squad's individual members; it states only the contributing clans ('the Abe Clan's elite forces that also included the Sugawara Clan's remnants'), which is the closed set staged as id 103.

retired.question: Every Culling Game player Angel is related to or fought
retired.reason: Predicate roster the page does not close: related or fought players (Maki Zenin, Kogane, Sukuna) appear in scattered scene beats, and no closed list of players is stated on the page.

retired.question: Every person who saved or healed Hana Kurusu
retired.reason: The page hedges: 'saved earlier by Rin Amai and possibly Takaba'; the 'possibly' leaves the set open, so it is not closed.

retired.question: Every incarnated Culling Game player the Angel seeks to kill
retired.reason: The page targets 'all her fellow incarnated players' in general but names only one specifically (Sukuna, the 'Disgraced One'); no closed roster of incarnated players is stated on the page.

retired.question: Every present-day ally of the Angel
retired.reason: The page lists 'Megumi, Yuji Itadori, and co.'; the 'and co.' leaves the ally set open.

retired.question: Who does the Angel distrust?
retired.reason: Not stated on the page; the only trust gap the page states runs the other way (Yuji Itadori 'takes no orders from someone he does not trust' -- the Angel).

retired.question: Who does the Angel respect or look up to?
retired.reason: Not stated on the page; no admired or looked-up-to person is named.

retired.question: Who are Hana Kurusu's relatives?
retired.reason: Not stated on the page; no kin of either Hana or the Angel is named.
